formulas.ascii: Cut gain, not the procedure: cutting tree edge e splits region R into the child side C_e (A) and the remainder (B). The within-region sum of squares falls by g_e = SSD(R) - SSD(C_e) - SSD(R \ C_e), computed in the direct Ward form g_e = nA nB / nR * sum_c (S_Ac / nA - (S_Rc - S_Ac) / nB)^2, with nB = nR - nA and S the per-column attribute sums of the child subtree and of the region (no cancellation of sums of squares). A NaN or infinite gain is not a candidate. Each step applies the largest gain (ties to the lowest edge slot) whose two sides both keep minimumRegionSize rows, until the target region count is reached.
